courses.title: Move, pin and collapse the SHAPE toolbar
courses.objective: The floating SHAPE / FACE / EDGE bar can be dragged out of the way, pinned where you put it, collapsed to its name, and reset — so it never blocks the object you want to pick.

steps.title: Make a plate with a hole
instructions: A 60 × 40 × 15 plate with a Ø18 hole is built for you.
Open the AakarFORM tab and click the top face of the plate: the floating bar appears next to it.
steps.why: You need something selected to see the bar.

checkpoint.expected: A plate with a hole and a floating FACE bar.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step.

steps.title: Drag the bar by its grip
instructions: Press and hold the dotted grip (⠿) at the left end of the bar and drag it to a free corner.
Release: the bar is now PINNED there (the ○ button turns ◉).
steps.why: A pinned bar stays put when you select something else, so it no longer covers the geometry.

checkpoint.expected: The bar sits where you dropped it and the pin button is on.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step.

build.note: Drag the bar by its grip

steps.title: Select something else
instructions: Click a side face, then an edge.
The bar keeps its place and changes its buttons to match the selection.
steps.why: The bar follows the selection only while it is not pinned.

checkpoint.expected: The bar stayed in the corner while the selection changed.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step.

steps.title: Collapse the bar
instructions: Click ▾ at the right end of the bar: only its name and the two small buttons remain.
Click ▸ to bring the buttons back.
steps.why: A collapsed bar needs very little room, but is still one click away.

checkpoint.expected: Collapsed bar shows only the name.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step.

steps.title: Let it follow the selection again
instructions: Double-click the grip (⠿), or press ◉ , or use AakarFORM › Pick › Reset bar.
steps.why: Reset puts the bar back above the selection with all its buttons.

checkpoint.expected: The bar sits next to the selection again.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step.

build.note: Let it follow the selection again
